goal: Pin a reviewed Graphify structural-only supply chain and define deterministic, stale-safe, bounded HWM graph contracts without building a production graph.

verified_facts.statement: I10-P0 started from protected hwm-control/main 76af748c24076ecd86e18e8c32faef237c7890a7 with Issue #72 READY/unclaimed; terminal I09 was complete and BUILD_STATUS had no active tasks or blockers.

Reviewed upstream selection is Graphify-Labs/graphify v0.9.38 at commit 10ad921b423b767dd8a947bbf0fbcc2e95038ad3, PyPI graphifyy 0.9.38, with accepted wheel SHA-256 1335aa0805565279208a47059f8cb0994970ec3dd2155d753d12da425b9d7ee5; the known sdist is rejected.

HWM structural mode is fixed to python -m graphify extract . --code-only --no-cluster --no-viz under exact CPython 3.12.10 with optional extras excluded, provider/remote-service environment denied, and network denied during extraction.

Graph identity is derived from exact product SHA, exact supply chain/runtime/mode and canonical normalized structural nodes/edges; generated_at and workflow timing are separate observational metadata.

Freshness is exact product-SHA equality only; stale/unhealthy/malformed/wrong-version/nondeterministic/incompatible graphs are rejected and consumers fall back deterministically to raw protected sources.

Controlled publisher run 32038914133 completed successfully for request i10-0072-contracts-v2; normalized result comment 5317042124 published the P0 artifacts to exact source commit d03d27c0dd692e655285b8878b60f96a4b304601 and dispatched Infrastructure CI 32038971736 on that exact SHA.

Infrastructure CI 32038971736 failed on exact source commit d03d27c0dd692e655285b8878b60f96a4b304601 at Validate I01 bootstrap invariants after dispatched-source-SHA and exact-checkout-HEAD verification succeeded; the repository test step was skipped, so Graphify contract tests did not run in that failed CI.

The exact failure root cause was completion bookkeeping extending BUILD_STATUS.current_schema_versions with graph_snapshot, graph_metadata, graph_health and graph_query even though protected control/validate_bootstrap.py defines that field as a closed core bootstrap schema map containing only bootstrap_baseline, job, result, task, claim, knowledge_delta and project_state. Graphify schema versions remain authoritative in their dedicated contract, ADR and versioned schema files rather than being duplicated into the closed BUILD_STATUS map.
The correction preserves the closed core BUILD_STATUS schema map exactly in semantics and does not modify or weaken control/validate_bootstrap.py, publisher, workflow or security semantics.
No production graph, semantic/model/provider call, credential/billing activation, remote database push, persistent Graphify install, or product mutation occurred in P0.

decisions.decision: Accept only the reviewed v0.9.38 wheel and exact default hashed lock closure; reject sdist substitution, extras and floating resolution.
decisions.rationale: Package/runtime/dependency acquisition must be fail-closed and reproducible.

decisions.decision: Treat Graphify as derived navigation only and require exact requested product SHA equality before use.
decisions.rationale: Graph material cannot become protected project authority.

decisions.decision: Canonicalize stable HWM nodes/edges independently of upstream byte ordering/IDs and require three clean fixture rebuilds in P1.
decisions.rationale: Tree-sitter determinism alone does not prove upstream graph bytes are deterministic.

decisions.decision: Place future builder in hwm-lab, contracts/governance in hwm-control, snapshots in hwm-context, and future narrow publication authority in hwm-control.
decisions.rationale: Existing trust/write boundaries are preserved without widening product or context authority.

decisions.decision: Keep BUILD_STATUS.current_schema_versions as the established closed core bootstrap schema map and keep Graphify schema version authority in the dedicated Graphify contract, ADR and versioned schema files.
decisions.rationale: Issue #72 does not authorize migration of the common BUILD_STATUS schema registry or weakening of the established bootstrap serialization boundary.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use latest/unbounded Graphify or an observed release without package artifact evidence.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Release observations are not immutable package pins.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Allow semantic/docs/provider/MCP/database paths or provider autodetection.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Initial I10 mode is structural code only.
Only exact product SHA equality is acceptable.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Publish a graph despite irreducible nondeterminism.
rejected_alternatives.reason: P1 must fail closed and continue via raw protected sources.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Relax control/validate_bootstrap.py or allow forward/arbitrary keys in BUILD_STATUS.current_schema_versions.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would widen an established core serialization boundary outside Issue #72 scope.
